DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: お疲れ、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: えっと、面談は今日でいいんだよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 待たせちゃってごめんね。今日で大丈夫だよ。

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あははっ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: シャーレの仕事が忙しいのは分かってるし、しょうがないよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あたしからお願いしたわけだしさ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: んじゃ、昼過ぎには着くからよろしくね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、待ってるね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: はーい、また後で

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちょっとお願いがあるんだけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 仕事で忙しいかな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ルミの頼みなら、いつでも喜んで

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……ふふっ、そっか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 本当だね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: だったら……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 玄武商会が、というか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 正確には、あたしの個人的な試作品なんだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: よかったら試食してもらえないかな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ルミの新しい料理！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まだ試作段階だけどね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生の都合がいいタイミングで、玄武商会まで来てもらえるかな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 待ってるね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、元気にしてる？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 毎食、ちゃんと欠かさずに食べてるよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ちゃんと食べてるよ……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 山海経に用事があって、いま向かってるところなんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: おっ、そうなの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 時間があれば、玄武商会に寄ってね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 特別にサービスしてあげるよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生は知らないかもしれないけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 玄武商会には、「今週の料理」っていうのがあるんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今週の……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そ。毎週、違う料理が選ばれてね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いつもよりちょっと安い特別価格で提供してるんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それで……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 「今週の料理」は[ruby=チャオズ]餃子[/ruby]なの

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 餃子……美味しそう……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: だから今日の午前中は

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ずっと餃子を蒸すことになりそうでさ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 見に行ってもいい？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: おっ、気になるの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いつでも来てもらって大丈夫だよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生の予定が空いてるなら、だけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今日はちょうど、午前の仕事がないんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そうだったんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 分かった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それじゃ、玄武商会で待ってるね

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 미안해. 좀 더 일찍 시간을 내주고 싶었는데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 공사가 다망한 샬레의 선생님이니, 어쩔 수 없지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그러면 오늘은 괜찮은 걸로 알고 찾아가겠어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 점심을 조금 지난 시간 정도에 도착할 것 같은데, 괜찮겠지?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 또 일이 너무 많이 밀렸다거나 하는 거 아니야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아니, 내가 새로운 맛 내기를 구상해 봤는데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어때. 시식해 보러 올 생각 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭐, 생각이 있다면 현무상회로 찾아와 주면 고맙겠어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 난 언제든지 선생님을 기다리고 있을 테니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 또 식사 거르고 다니는 거 아니지?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 마침 산해경에 들를 일이 좀 있는데 말이야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님에게라면 얼마든지 서비스해 줄 수 있으니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 현무상회에는 이번 주의 요리라는 게 있어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 말 그대로, 이번 주에는 이 요리를

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 조금 더 싼 가격에 판매한다는 뜻이지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그리고 오늘부터 시작하는 이번 주의 요리는……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 신기하게도 간만에 오전 중 업무가 없는 날입니다.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hello, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You're free today, right?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm sorry. I wanted to make time for you earlier.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hahaha.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Of course Schale keeps you busy. What can you do?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Then, I'll assume you're available, and come see you today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I should arrive just a little after lunch time. Is that okay?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll be waiting.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Okay, I'll see you then.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Do you have time right now?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You're not going to tell me that you're backed up with work again, are you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: If it's for a student, I'll make the time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...Really? Are you sure?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hmm.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Okay.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm at the Black Tortoise Promenade...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And I'm working on a new dish...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Do you think you can come taste it?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: A new recipe from Rumi?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You can say that.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well, if you have a chance, I'd really love it if you could come meet me at the Black Tortoise Promenade.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll always be waiting for you, Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: How are you, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You're not skipping your meals again, are you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I don't do that anymore...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm going to be stopping by Shanhaijing.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh, really?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Stop by the Black Tortoise Promenade, too, if you have a chance.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'd love to take care of you, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You probably don't know but...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: We've got a special at the Black Tortoise Promenade.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What is it?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Just like the name suggests, it means that a certain dish

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: will be sold at a discount this week.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And the dish starting today happens to be...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Dumplings!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Dumplings... That's great!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yeah, so I'll be steaming dumplings

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: for the rest of the morning!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Can I come see?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh, a visit from Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I have no objection.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If you have time, that is.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Amazingly, I'm free this morning.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Is that so?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'd love for you to come.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll be waiting.

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: สวัสดีคุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้มีเวลาว่างใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ขอโทษด้วยนะ ครูก็อยากหาเวลาว่าง
ให้เร็วกว่านี้แท้ๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮ่าฮ่าฮ่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ช่วยไม่ได้นี่นา ก็คุณครูเป็นครูของชาเล่ต์
ที่มีงานรัดตัวตลอดนี่นา

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าอย่างนั้น ฉันจะถือว่าคุณครูว่าง
แล้วเข้าไปหาก็แล้วกันนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันน่าจะไปถึงหลังเที่ยงนิดหน่อย
เวลานั้นสะดวกใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้นครูจะรอนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นไว้เจอกันนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ตอนนี้ว่างหรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อย่าบอกนะว่ามีงานรอระบาย
อยู่เยอะอีกแล้วน่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: สำหรับนักเรียน ครูมีเวลาให้เสมอ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: พูดจริง... ใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เยี่ยมเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: รอบนี้ย่านการค้าเทพเต่าดำ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คือว่าฉันลองคิดค้นเมนูอาหาร
ใหม่ๆ อยู่น่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ว่าไง อยากมาลองชิมดูหน่อยมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เมนูใหม่ของรูมิงั้นเหรอ?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็ประมาณนั้นแหละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าคุณครูว่างละก็ มาที่ย่านการค้าเทพเต่าดำ
หน่อยได้มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ว่าเมื่อไรฉันก็จะรอคุณครูนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครูสบายดีมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่ได้ลืมกินอาหารหรืออะไรอีก
ใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูไม่ทำแบบนั้นแล้ว...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูมีธุระที่ต้องแวะไปแถวๆ
ซานไห่จิงพอดีน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: โอ้... อย่างนั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าพอมีเวลาละก็ แวะมาย่านการค้า
เทพเต่าดำด้วยสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันจะต้อนรับดูแลคุณครู
อย่างดีเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครูอาจจะไม่รู้...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ย่านการค้าเทพเต่าดำมีเมนูประจำ
สัปดาห์ด้วยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มันคืออะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ก็ตามชื่อของมันนั่นแหละ มันหมายความว่า
อาหารชนิดนั้น

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
จะขายในราคาถูกลงกว่าเดิมใน
สัปดาห์นั้นๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
และเมนูประจำสัปดาห์ที่เริ่มวางขาย
วันนี้ก็คือ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เกี๊ยวนั่นเอง

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เกี๊ยว... ฟังดูดีเลย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เพราะงั้นตลอดช่วงเช้าวันนี้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คงต้องนึ่งเกี๊ยวกันยาวๆ เลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูไปดูได้มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
โอ้... คุณครูจะมาสังเกตการณ์
งั้นหรือ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันไม่มีเหตุผลที่จะปฏิเสธ
สักหน่อย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้าคุณครูสะดวกจะมานะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: นานๆ ทีจะว่างตอนเช้าด้วย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นก็ได้เลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันจะรอนะ

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那個，今天可以面談對吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 抱歉讓你久等了。今天可以唷

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我知道夏萊的工作很忙，這也沒辦法

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那，我下午會過去，請多指教囉

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 如果是瑠美的請求，我隨時都樂意幫忙

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 準確來說，是我個人的試作品

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不介意的話可以麻煩你試吃嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然還在試作階段就是了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 可以請老師有空的時候到玄武商會來嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我現在正好有事要去一趟山海經

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 有時間的話就來玄武商會吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 玄武商會有所謂的「本週料理」

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 沒錯。每週都會選出不同的料理

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 並以略為便宜的價格提供給客人

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這次的「本週料理」是餃子

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 恐怕都得在廚房裡蒸餃子了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我今天早上正好沒有工作

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那我在玄武商會等你哦
